title: Women and Climate Vulnerability

body.en: Aba sells vegetables at a market in the Central Region. Two years ago, the stream near her town ran all year. Now it dries up for months at a time. On the days it's dry, she walks nearly two hours further to fetch water for her household before she can even open her stall — time she used to spend earning. When the rains do come, they come harder and faster than before, and twice last year her unsold stock was ruined when the market flooded overnight. Aba says the hardest part isn't any single bad day. It's that she can no longer plan a week ahead, because she doesn't know which kind of day is coming.
